info.title: API.SH: Himalayas
info.description: The Himalayas API from API.SH: public Himalayas data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Browse or search the remote-friendly companies on Himalayas, by keyword, country, worldwide hiring, benefits and tech stack, in five sort orders. Each company: slug, name, link, location, open positions, markets, counts of tech stack entries, benefits and salary insights, and an about excerpt. 20 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-companies

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country the company hires in, e.g. `Germany`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A company's open remote jobs, with the same filters, sorts, fields and paging as /himalayas/v1/search (pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page). 404 when the company does not exist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-company-jobs

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword: job title, role or skill, e.g. `react engineer`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country the job is open to: ISO code, name or slug (`US`, `Germany`, `united-kingdom`). Includes worldwide roles open to that country unless `exclude_worldwide=true`.

parameters.name: exclude_worldwide
parameters.description: `true` with `country`: only jobs restricted to that country.

parameters.name: seniority
parameters.description: One or more, comma-separated: Entry-level, Mid-level, Senior, Manager, Director, Executive (lowercase and `entry`/`mid`/`junior` accepted).

parameters.name: employment_type
parameters.description: One or more, comma-separated: Full Time, Part Time, Contractor, Temporary, Intern, Volunteer, Other (`full-time`, `contract`, `internship` accepted).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: UTC offset the job accepts: `-5`, `UTC-5` or `UTC+05:30`.

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD (hourly pay counts as x 2080). Switches to the summary search (see description).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Only jobs paid in this currency (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR and other ISO codes).

parameters.name: salary_required
parameters.description: With a salary filter: `false` also returns jobs without a listed salary (default true).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevant (default), recent, salaryAsc, salaryDesc, nameAToZ, nameZToA, jobs (the last three without salary/market/benefit filters).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 jobs a page, up to 250).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.total_note: an estimate from the site that can run slightly high

get.description:
One remote job by its link (or company and job slug): everything in a search result plus `skills`, `education` and `experience` requirements and `is_open`. A job that has closed answers with `is_open: false` and its closing date. `company` + `latest=true` returns that company's newest open job.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-job

parameters.description: `true` with `company`: the company's most recently posted open job.

get.description:
Every open remote job on Himalayas, most recently updated first. Each job: title, company name, slug and logo, job and company links, application link, employment type, seniority, countries it is open to (`location_restrictions`, empty = worldwide), accepted UTC offsets, categories and parent categories, salary min/max with currency and period, excerpt, full description (text and HTML), published and expiry dates, and `raw`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. The feed never repeats a job while you walk it.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-jobs

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the remote jobs on Himalayas with every filter the site offers: keyword, country, worldwide-only, seniority, employment type, company, timezone, salary range, pay currency, markets and benefits, with seven sort orders. Each job: title, company name, slug and logo, job and company links, application link, employment type, seniority, countries it is open to (`location_restrictions`, empty = worldwide), accepted UTC offsets, categories and parent categories, salary min/max with currency and period, excerpt, full description (text and HTML), published and expiry dates, and `raw`. With `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `currency`, `salary_required`, `markets` or `benefits` the search runs on the site's salary-aware search: each job then has title, company, slugs, link, employment type, countries, posted date, salary (min, max, currency, period, yearly equivalent), categories and key skills, without the description (get it from /himalayas/v1/job); seniority and employment_type take one value each there and `timezone` is not available. Pages hold 20 jobs; pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). `total` is the site's estimate (it stops counting at a cap).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-search

get.description:
The top 30 skills, job categories, countries or industries on Himalayas by number of remote jobs or companies, optionally in one country: rank, name, slug, region (for countries) and count, plus the total number of entries.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/himalayas-statistics

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: For record=jobs: `skills` (default), `categories` or `countries`; for record=companies: `industries` (default) or `countries`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
